messages:
maria: Seeing a sudden spike of 502/504s for hosted inference from guest accounts since ~09:10 UTC. Multiple customers reporting mid-stream failures. Example traces: trace=abc123 def456. Any quick ideas?

rahul: I see a concurrent jump in h2 resets from envoy + upstream connection failures. Nginx/Envoy logs show a lot of RST_STREAM and GOAWAYs.

oncall-sre: can you paste an access log sample and confirm whether this lines up with any auth/token rotations or a deploy? also pinging ops-bot.

maria: sample below from envoy (redacted):

```
[2026-03-15T09:12:11Z] trace=abc123 client=1.2.3.4 "POST /v1/hosted/infer HTTP/2" 502 0 "-" "rust-sdk/1.2"
upstream reset: connection failure to 10.4.2.8:443
local: connection_window_size=65536
```

jessica: reproduced with curl against the frontdoor -> envoys on shard-12. Long-lived h2 streams look fine for ~45-60s then we see delayed WINDOW_UPDATEs followed by resets. Hypothesis: keepalive/window drift + auth-proxy queue growth on shard-12 after the 08:50 rollout.

ops-bot: deploy 2026-03-15T08:50 rolled to shard-12 (deploy-id: deploy-2026-03-15-0850). Marking shard-12 as suspect. @rahul please confirm.

rahul: verifying metrics now: shard-12 shows spike in h2 GOAWAY count and a concurrent ~5x increase in auth-proxy queue length and auth cache misses. Also a small uptick in CPU steal on the worker pods (no OOMs).

maria: repro steps we used locally:
```
curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" \
  -H "Accept: text/event-stream" \
  https://api.redwood.ai/v1/hosted/stream
```
Short sessions succeed, streaming sessions fail after ~60s with a 504 (upstream timeout) or a 502 when the connection is forcibly reset.

oncall-sre: short mitigation suggestion: route guest/anonymous traffic away from shard-12 via routing policy (failover to shard-9/10). Also bump envoy h2 initial window temporarily to see if it reduces resets.

jessica: applied shard routing change at 09:22 UTC. Within 10 minutes 502/504 rate for guest traffic on the frontdoor dropped ~80%. Looks promising.

rahul: next steps: roll back the 08:50 kernel patch on shard-12 (suspected change in keepalive/window handling), run a controlled canary of updated auth cache settings, and add an alert for auth-proxy queue > 100. Also collecting full logs for PM.

maria: uploading logs to /mnt/triage/shard12-logs.tar.gz and will attach to the customer ticket. Drafting a customer message with workaround and ETA. :thumbsup:

oncall-sre: creating internal incident ticket with timeline and assigning postmortem owner. Thanks team — keep updates in this thread and paste the rollback plan when ready.

jessica: rollback scheduled 10:05 UTC on shard-12, will monitor. Will post final status and follow-up RCA after soak.
